The '''Barrenwoods''' was the name given to the northwestern region of the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] constructed a number of monoliths in the area.<ref name="TOR" />
